### problem_chain

Root (the only problem the customer raises: "I'd like to cancel it and get a refund for the visits I didn't use"): package_ext_cancellation_refund on package e52dea15 (Complete 12-Visit). Its rule's prerequisite sentence: "No refund is worked out until the package stands active again with the visits removed at its expiry credited back." At 2026-10-05: false — visit_packages/e52dea15 status expired (expiry_date 2026-09-16, closed 2026-09-17), package_events a0ed7ec4 package_visits_expired 5 visits, no package_visits_credited of kind reinstatement.

Resolving write found from the other rules: package_ext_reinstatement_charge ("the reinstatement returns it to active status, credits back the visits removed at its expiry") — eligible: base window "no later than reinstatement_window_days calendar days after the expiry date on file", 2026-09-16 -> 2026-10-05 = 19 <= 30; never reinstated; tier window 30 > 0. It carries no prerequisite.

Tree: {cancellation (root, owner user), reinstatement (agent)}; edge cancellation <- reinstatement [value_input, cap_value]. n = 1, value_input edges 1 >= 1. Acyclic. One owner=user problem (persona: "You want to confirm the cancellation yourself"). Order: reinstatement -> cancellation.

Load-bearing run: refund after reinstatement 284.00; skipping the reinstatement (standing visits 0, no reinstatement credit -> no cap, no handling charge) the same compute gives 505.00. Bears (besides the active-status requirement of the rule "A package in active status is cancelled").
Tools judge no prerequisite (`_difficulty.md` §action_binding_and_uuids): confirm_package_cancellation_a8d08ce2 cancels whatever package it is given.
Persona: raises only the root; reinstatement appears only conditionally ("If the agent explains that the package has to be reinstated before it can be cancelled ..."). Its one question, "whether that still leaves you better off", is answered from the charter's own figures (without reinstatement no refund rule applies to an expired package; with it 284.00 back against 27.25 paid) and needs no write. The call closes at "Once the agent tells you the cancellation is confirmed and the refund is on its way".

## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — mislabelled effect on forfeit_charge** (charter-global F-3 in `_difficulty.md` §findings).
   - Symptom: a factor labelled `method` whose tiers only change a multiplier.
   - Root cause / evidence: ladder "charge every forfeited visit at the used-visit value" / "charge every forfeited visit at half the used-visit value" / "charge nothing for forfeited visits"; compute `forfeit_charge: "all_forfeits * used_rate if noshow_forfeits >= 1 else (all_forfeits * used_rate / 2 if all_forfeits >= 1 else 0)"` = all_forfeits x used_rate x s, s in {1, 1/2, 0}.
   - Demonstrated consequence: on this world the tier taken (no-show 9ee94983) is s = 1 -> 103.00; the same formula with s = 1/2 or 0 gives the other tiers. It is a `parameter`; the computation's honest count is 5 parameter / 1 method (used_visit_value), so the floor still holds, but the declared label is false.
   - Affected: package.extended.yaml package_ext_cancellation_refund.factors[2]; computations[step 11].factor_trace.
   - Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
2. Observation — O-1 (reinstatement coverage credit omits `closed` plans in compute) does not touch this world: plan 42133ef4 is active.
3. Observation — the persona's question "whether that still leaves you better off" has a determinate answer from the charter (no rule refunds an expired package; with reinstatement 284.00 back for 27.25 paid) and needs no write; it moves the agent past no gold action.
